W.note: Correct and simple, but cells only say 'Cell n' to screen readers, there is no custom focus style, and the look is plain.

X.note: Correct and tidy, with row/column/state aria labels, a focus ring, dark mode and a 44px button; the draw message is a bit wordy.

Y.note: Bold, friendly blue look, but the board rows visibly squash at the end state, and aria-disabled cells still take clicks and focus.

Z.note: Correct and clean, but screen-reader labels are bare 'Cell n' and the starter-flip setup is awkward.
